findings.claim: The goals list "four incompatible manifest.json shapes" as a survey finding to confirm, but the assessment reports only three shapes and never reconciles the missing fourth.
findings.evidence: Goals: "four incompatible `manifest.json` shapes" under survey-only findings to confirm. Artifact: "Manifest schema: [PARTIAL]" enumerates exactly three sources (research-package-spec.md int, template array, export-package.sh omits the field), and GOAL PROGRESS G1 says "three manifest shapes" — the discrepancy with the goal's count of four is never explained.
findings.suggested_fix: Either identify the fourth manifest shape (e.g. a fourth writer/reader such as the daemon's config.rs or checkpoint.rs) or explicitly state that the survey count was wrong and three is the verified number.

findings.claim: Open question 4 invites analyze to descope G5, a stated goal, and its rationale contradicts the assessment's own G5 findings.
findings.evidence: Artifact: "Whether G5 belongs in this phase or a successor; it is the only goal with no correctness defect behind it." But the goals define G5 as in-scope ("G5 Scoring: source credibility uses available-signal weight renormalization..."), and the assessment itself marks G5 NOT MET with three [MISSING] items (weight renormalization, content-addressed claim IDs, contradicts edges) — missing required features are defects against the goal.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the descoping framing or reframe it strictly as a sequencing question; goal membership is not the assess stage's to re-open, and the 'no defect' rationale is unsupported.

findings.claim: Compile health of the Rust crates G1 must modify is unverified, yet the assessment asserts the daemon compiles on survey-only evidence.
findings.evidence: BUILD HEALTH: "build check: UNKNOWN — ... `cargo check -p prometheus-research` was not run" immediately followed by "the daemon compiles per the survey (tests exist and are described as real)". G1 requires fixing spawn.rs and checkpoint.rs in this crate; existence of test files does not demonstrate compilation.
findings.suggested_fix: Either run `cargo check -p prometheus-research` and `cargo check -p learner-model` before closing assess, or downgrade the compiles claim to UNKNOWN and add it to OPEN QUESTIONS FOR ANALYZE as a blocking precondition, not a footnote.

findings.claim: Several verified findings have no corresponding goal, creating scope-smuggling risk when the plan stage selects work.
findings.evidence: The 'Documentation drift (cross-cutting)' section (skill.toml:31 stale deferral note, SKILL.md:199 broken link, SKILL.md:107 version mismatch, A2UI component name mismatch) and 'Loop control in feynman-loop (depth cap, recursion floor, escalation, three-criterion closure): [STUB]' map to none of G1–G5; the goals mention no documentation or loop-control requirement.
findings.suggested_fix: Tag each orphan finding with the goal it serves (e.g. doc drift under C-03 compliance for G1 surface changes) or explicitly mark it 'deferred — out of phase scope' so plan cannot absorb it silently.
